text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally need human intelligence. Machine learning is a part of AI where computers learn from data without being told every step. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks to solve difficult problems. AI is already part of our daily lives. For example, it helps us unlock our phones with our faces, suggests films we might enjoy, and answers our questions through voice assistants. It also helps doctors find diseases and cars drive more safely. In short, AI is changing the way we live and work.
